summary_plain: Moves about 12 arcseconds per hour across 19 images over 31.0 hours. Not yet checked against JPL's catalog of known asteroids and comets.

orbit.reported_orbit: The arc is too short to fix one orbit, so this is the most circular of the 462 sampled orbits that fit the detections; the clones show the range.

known_object.not_checked_reason: JPL Horizons did not answer for 10939 Maheshwari (1999 CJ19), the closest known object (about 75″ away in JPL's quick search).

scores.definition: Rule-based ranking score in [0, 1]: motion_consistency x snr x (1 - artifact_likelihood). It orders candidates for review. It is not a probability.

history.change: linked 19 detections over 3 visits from 2025-05-10 to 2025-05-11

disclaimer: An unmatched candidate may be an imaging artifact, a measurement error, or an object missing from the catalogs we checked. This is not a discovery claim.
